freePlan.limits: Basic free account with limited storage and features, cannot be downgraded back to after subscribing

keyLimits.en: 1 audio podcast, 1 GB monthly uploads (~16 hrs audio), unlimited total storage
2 audio/video podcasts, 10 GB monthly uploads (~160 hrs audio or 10 hrs video)
Unlimited public podcasts, 40 GB monthly uploads, up to 50 team members, 3 TB monthly bandwidth
Unlimited private podcasts plus 2 public ones, 40 GB monthly uploads, unmetered bandwidth, unlimited team members

cautions.en: Uploads are capped monthly even on "Unlimited" plans (e.g. 1 GB/month on Unlimited Audio); the "unlimited" branding refers to total storage retention, not monthly upload volume.
Once subscribed to a paid plan, an account cannot be downgraded back to the free tier.

capabilities.en: Podcast hosting and one-click distribution to Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Amazon Music, iHeartRadio and other directories.
Built-in monetization: dynamic ad insertion, an ads marketplace, and listener subscriptions (Apple Podcasts subscriptions support).
AI credits included on paid plans for AI-assisted podcast production tools.
Network-level and advanced analytics on the Network and Business plans.

limitations.en: The entry paid plan (Unlimited Audio) allows only 1 podcast and 1 GB of monthly uploads, which is restrictive for active or multi-show creators.
Multiple team member/admin access is unavailable on the lower tiers (Unlimited Audio, Unlimited Plus).

reason.en: Direct competitor for podcast hosting and distribution.
Podcast hosting platform with a strong monetization/ad marketplace focus, similar positioning.
